purpose: the frozen pre-analysis selection: hashes, verified invariants, the eligible identifier list and the deterministic 20,000-row selection - all fixed BEFORE any METER or MIRT execution so no different sample can later be regenerated under the same nominal seed and configuration

verified_invariants.lexical_match: all 50 codebook items matched the published IPIP key reference

eligibility.rule: IPC == 1 AND all 50 mapped items observed (no 0)
eligibility.identifier_definition: 0-based row index in canonical file order of data-final.csv

selection.method: numpy default_rng(9500).choice over the sorted eligible index array, without replacement, result sorted ascending
selection.no_redraw_rule: this selection is final: no replacement of excluded respondents, no redraw, and no re-derivation under any circumstance including inconvenient results
